purpose: Separate the effect of deleting residual flows from sampling and PCA changes. The first run redrew every few-shot row because the pools shifted and it refit PCA, so its paired differences mix three changes.
approval: Same user request as the first run: few-shot with residual flows deleted. This run corrects the comparison design.
sampling: Each job reuses the EXP94 selected flows of its seed and regime in the same order. A selected flow that is residual is replaced by a draw from the remaining train flows of that class with seed + 1009 * class + 777, at the same position, so smaller budgets stay prefixes.

arms.flowstats-v1: Statistics view on the remaining rows.
arms.netfound-exp94-pca: EXP94 PCA vectors of the remaining rows. Only deletion and replaced rows differ from EXP94.
arms.netfound-refit-pca: PCA vectors of the first run, refit on the remaining train rows.

scoring: One scoring only: the test rows that remain after deletion. EXP94 is recomputed from saved predictions on exactly these rows.
inherited: Flow IDs, labels, splits, seeds 43 to 47, budgets 2 to 50, regimes, XGB and TabPFN settings and checkpoint come from protocol_snapshot.json of the base run.
